displayedInputs.question:
A cylinder has a height of 10 centimeters and a base radius of 2 centimeters. Only the height in centimeters is asked for. Calculate: \(10+0=?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of a cylinder with a base radius of 2 centimeters and a height of 5 centimeters? Use \(314/100\) for \(\pi\).

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of a cylinder with a base radius of 1 centimeter and a height of 10 centimeters? Use \(314/100\) for \(\pi\).

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of a cylinder with a base area of 12 square centimeters and a height of 4 centimeters? Calculate: \(12\times4=?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

The lateral surface unfolds into a rectangle 6.28 centimeters long and 5 centimeters wide. What is the lateral surface area in square centimeters? Calculate: \(6.28\times5=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

What shape is the base of a cone?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

A cylinder has a volume of 30 cubic centimeters. What is the volume of a cone with the same base area and height? Calculate: \(30\div3=?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

In the figure, it is given that angle \(C=90^\circ,\) \(AD=DB,\) \(DE\perp AB,\) \(AB=20,\) and \(AC=12.\) The area of quadrilateral \(ADEC\) is:

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
